title: Cebu City clarifies: No ASF outbreak in Barangay Sapangdaku

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Department of Veterinary Medicine and Fisheries (DVMF) clarified that there are no confirmed African swine fever (ASF)-positive cases in Barangay Sapangdaku, following reports of hog deaths and the establishment of a checkpoint to prevent the disease from spreading to other communities. The clarification came after the city intensified surveillance in the mountain barangay, where reports had circulated about the alleged presence of ASF. The DVMF said the checkpoint and other monitoring measures were preventive actions and did not mean an outbreak had been confirmed in Sapangdaku.
